project.title: Characteristics and mechanisms of enhanced degradation of 2,4-difluoroaniline in a biochemical system mediated by magnetic biochar under Cu2+impact conditions
project.description: The main goals of this article were as follows:(1) develop the PACT process, and evaluate the effects of the biochar type, the bacteria and biochar addition method on the treatment efficiencies under different concentrations of Cu(II) shock; (2) evaluate the contributions of biochar and EPS to 2,4-difluoroaniline (2,4-DFA) degradation and Cu(II) removal in the PACT system; (3)explore the effects of biochar on EPS production, and its adsorption capacity for Cu(II); (4) assess the relationship of the microbial community composition and the biochar type, the addition method in the PACT system.
